'''''Cast Wing in Flight''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting depicted an [[Artist/Legends|artist's]] sketch<ref name="SWG" /> of a [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]], an assault [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Company]].<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Cast Wing in Flight'' was a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The image used for the painting came from the art book ''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The ship itself was added in the game's first expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], in [[2004]] as an enemy-controlled ship and became player-obtainable as part of the ''Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis'' update on [[January 15]], [[2008]]. The painting was one of nine paintings given out randomly to players of the game for the game's first anniversary of release in the United States and Europe. The painting was later added to the "rare loot system" in ''Hotfix 17.10'' on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. The system allowed players to loot rare items from any enemy in the game. The player could use the painting in their house as decoration.
